name: Kishi Mamoru
source: A career police officer, but after a certain incident he has become lazy and puts little effort into his job. Is this really behavior becoming of a police officer? Eisuke is bribing him to keep the police from knowing about the auctions.
translation: A career police officer, but after a certain incident he has become lazy and puts little effort into his job. Is this really behavior becoming of a police officer? Eisuke is bribing him to keep the police from knowing about the auctions.
